exposure: Number of repeat caesarean sections (4 vs 5), elective vs. urgent cases
cohort: 110 patients undergoing their fourth or fifth caesarean section.
finding: Women undergoing their fourth or fifth caesarean section have an increased risk of perioperative complications, particularly those with risk factors like placenta previa and intra-abdominal adhesions.
